# Hassan Arslan — Full Stack Developer Portfolio

> Portfolio site for Hassan Arslan, a full stack developer based in Lahore, Pakistan, currently completing a BSCS degree. Builds production web applications using the MERN stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js) and PHP.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hassanarslan.dev/): Hero, about, skills, projects, and contact — a single-page portfolio.

## Projects

- [RG Tour & Travels](https://rgtravels.pk): A Hajj & Umrah travel agency site — package comparison across maktabs and tiers, testimonials, blog, and certifications. Built end to end (React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB).
- [Fitness Zone](https://fitnesszone.ltd): A women's wellness membership platform — diet plans and live workout sessions behind a member dashboard, with Stripe-powered checkout and subscription billing. Built end to end (React, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Stripe).

## Skills

React.js, JavaScript (ES6+), Node.js, Express.js, PHP, MongoDB, MySQL, Stripe API, C++, HTML5, CSS3, Git. Currently learning: Python, Django, Django REST Framework.
